title: keystore_load: entries array not zeroized before free on mlock failure
description: In wp11_keystore_load (src/wp11_keystore.c), when mlock of a der_bytes allocation fails for entry j, the handler munlocks entries 0..j-1 and the entries array, then falls into cleanup. The cleanup block correctly zeroes der_bytes contents via wp11_zero, but the entries array itself (containing key labels and IDs) is freed without prior zeroing. The pattern is inconsistent with the security goals of the module. Fix: add wp11_zero(entries, entry_alloc_size) before munlock(entries, entry_alloc_size) in the mlock-failure handler.
